title: sys_invocation_state cannot be read
body: The `sys_invocation_state` table can no longer be read. It looks that this is a regression compared to version 1.0. I suspect that the `MultiplexedInvokerStatusReader` is shared between components w/o having properly shared state.

linked_prs.title: Let MultiplexedInvokerStatusReader share state
linked_prs.body:
The MultiplexedInvokerStatusReader now shares the ChannelStatusReader via an Arc<Mutex<>>.

This fixes #1961.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns the reading of `sys_invocation_state`, which likely stores agent workflow or memory state. The mention of shared state and a component (`MultiplexedInvokerStatusReader`) suggests a problem in agent memory or workflow management, fitting the agent issue taxonomy (memory content errors or workflow issues).
